title: The container platform must protect authenticity of communications sessions with the use of FIPS-validated 140-2 or 140-3 security requirements for cryptographic modules.
check_content:
Review the container platform configuration to determine if FIPS-validated 140-2 or 140-3 cryptographic modules are being used to protect container images during transmission. 

If FIPS-validated 140-2 or 140-3 cryptographic modules are not being use, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the container platform to use FIPS-validated 140-2 or 140-3 cryptographic modules to protect container images during transmission.
VulnDiscussion: The container platform is responsible for pulling images from trusted sources and placing those images into its registry. To protect the transmission of images, the container platform must use FIPS-validated 140-2 or 140-3 cryptographic modules. This added protection defends against main-in-the-middle attacks where malicious code could be added to an image during transmission.
